subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: The wake channel shall record every check and every delivered wake as typed events, and the status verb shall render the last-check age, so that a dead checker is distinguishable from a quiet repo within one cadence interval.
rationale: silence must be loud (the predecessor's #1 class)
fit_criterion: kill-the-checker drill: within one cadence the status verb renders the stale last-check ⚠ and the event stream shows the gap
